purpose: Every STATICALLY_SOLVABLE and STATICALLY_AMBIGUOUS evidence question from analysis/reports/static-re-ceiling.json, each carrying a concrete named static avenue. This file supersedes the narrower Task 10/11 analysis/resources/static-discovery-backlog.json for corpus-wide planning purposes; static-discovery-backlog.json is preserved unmodified as the detailed working log for the boxer/resource-loader packages it already documents, several of whose entries are also referenced here. Per task policy, none of these may be moved to runtime-minimum-backlog.json until every named avenue below is exhausted.
